name: Activity Guidance & Exercise Safety Guardrails
purpose: Use genotype as a weak context modifier for training questions while keeping symptoms, medical history, progression, and professional clearance ahead of genetic optimization.
principles: Build from current ability, goals, symptoms, medications, sleep, nutrition, and training history; increase load gradually.
Let symptoms, medical history, measured data, and professional guidance outrank a genetic suggestion.
Use training recommendations as adjustable experiments with recovery feedback, not as a fixed genetic program.

simple_framework.label: Train
simple_framework.text: Progressive loading matched to current ability, symptoms, and recovery.

simple_framework.label: Recover
simple_framework.text: Treat sleep, hydration, nutrition, and recovery days as training variables.

simple_framework.label: Track
simple_framework.text: Log training load, soreness, performance, sleep, and symptoms; change one variable at a time.

stop_and_escalate: Chest pain, pressure, or unusual tightness during or after activity
Fainting, near-fainting, confusion, or unexplained severe dizziness
Unusual or severe shortness of breath, blue lips, or low oxygen
Fast or irregular heartbeat with symptoms
Dark urine, severe weakness, or severe muscle pain after exercise
Sudden neurologic symptoms, severe allergic symptoms, or heat-illness symptoms
